name: Rance IV - Kyoudan no Isan -
original_name: ランス IV　－教団の遺産－
source:
Following the events of Rance III, Rance is sent to Ylapu, a giant island floating above Leazas. There, Rance must find a way to return to The Continent's surface, while being hindered by agents from Helman who are attempting to revive and control the Wargod Upsilon, an ancient superweapon created by the Holy Magic Sect.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rance_(series)#Rance_IV:_Legacy_of_the_Sect]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
在《兰斯3》的事件结束后，兰斯被送往漂浮在利萨斯上空的巨型岛屿伊拉普。他必须设法回到大陆地表，同时还要对付来自赫尔曼的特工。这些人企图复活并控制斗神尤普西隆——圣魔教团在古代制造的超级兵器。

[编辑自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rance_(series)#Rance_IV:_Legacy_of_the_Sect]维基百科[/url]]
